'''Vidcomms '''were simple communication devices. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] one of these was used by the imperial [[Nilo (Imperial)|Nilo]] to contact [[Major General]] [[Carner]].<ref name="Whispers in the Dark">{{JournalCite|2|Whispers in the Dark}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
They may have been synonymous to the [[Vidcom]] mentioned in "''[[Join the Resistance: Attack on Starkiller Base]]."''
